vBRIEFInfo.description: Control channel: all message types, lifecycle state machine, keepalive, graceful close, error surfacing

narratives.Description: Implement the xumux control channel (0x00) in src/control/. Typed interfaces for all 10 control message types (HELLO, WELCOME, OPEN_CHANNEL, CHANNEL_ACK, CLOSE_CHANNEL, CHANNEL_REJECT, PING, PONG, CLOSE, ERROR) with JSON/UTF-8 payloads. A lifecycle state machine that handles client role (send HELLO, await WELCOME) and server role (await HELLO, send WELCOME, assign channel IDs). Dynamic channel management: OPEN_CHANNEL → CHANNEL_ACK/REJECT, CLOSE_CHANNEL, ID reuse after close. Keepalive: PING on configurable interval, PONG within timeout or close. Graceful close: CLOSE with reason, await echo, then close transport. Error surfacing: non-fatal errors as events, fatal errors thrown.
